title: Research Training and Scientific Discussions in the Kayode Lab
alt: A Kayode Lab student presents a scientific research workflow on a screen while fellow lab members listen and participate in a group discussion.
story:
At the Kayode Lab, we believe that strong research begins with a solid foundation in scientific knowledge and critical thinking. Throughout the Fall 2026 semester, our lab members have participated in regular meetings focused on building their understanding of molecular biology techniques, experimental design, and research methodologies.

These sessions combine student-led presentations, scientific literature discussions, and training in laboratory methods, including PCR, DNA extraction, sequencing technologies, and molecular diagnostics. Through these activities, students are developing the technical knowledge, critical thinking skills, and scientific communication abilities needed to become independent researchers.

As we prepare to transition into hands-on laboratory research, these meetings are helping establish a collaborative learning environment where students can ask questions, exchange ideas, and grow as scientists.
